cases.title: Snapshot events arrive duplicated and out of order
cases.prompt: Review consumer.py and the broker history. Explain the final account state and recommend the smallest reliable processing contract. Keep all files unchanged and use no external services.

rubric.criterion: Keeps account a at revision 12/gold after delayed revision 11; scopes order by account and uses the explicit snapshot contract rather than a universal drop-old-events rule.
Makes duplicate delivery produce no second audit effect through durable identity/atomicity, with safe concurrent arbitration rather than a process-local set.
Defines bounded malformed-message handling and tests duplicate/reordered/concurrent delivery plus commit-before-ack with concrete state/effect counts.
Leaves all supplied files unchanged, performs no external operation, and separates facts or commands actually observed from proposed checks. Does not claim unexecuted runtime validation.

cases.title: A committed consumer effect is delivered again
cases.prompt: Review the consumer and crash trace. Recommend a correction that states both database and external notification guarantees. Keep all files unchanged and use no external services.

rubric.criterion: Couples durable message ownership/result with the debit transaction and handles duplicate delivery after commit without a second debit.
Distinguishes an outbox/durable notification intent from exactly-once provider delivery; does not claim the email and debit share one atomic transaction.
Checks crashes before/after debit commit and before/after notification/ack, including concurrent duplicate claims, with explicit debit and notification expectations.

cases.title: A local callback has no durable messaging requirement
cases.prompt: Recommend the smallest change to notify the local listener after an in-memory counter changes. There is one owner and no cross-process consumer. Keep all files unchanged and use no external services.

rubric.criterion: Handles the narrow request without loading messaging-reliability or launching its specialist workflow. Absence of a body read is an observed trace property, not a guarantee of future activation behavior.
Proposes a direct listener call with the new value under the given synchronous contract; no broker/outbox/distributed retry system.
